entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell is this place? There's tons o'[n]computery stuff all over.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This is the central data hub.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This room's most likely where the data[n]sent over from the Palace goes.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, what's that on the screen?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Various locations within Mementos...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I presume this is less about surveillance[n]and more looking for targets, though.
Targets?
Why's that?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Think about it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: While all sorts of unnatural events may[n]be taking place in Maruki's reality...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...that doesn't mean every human's wish[n]has already been granted.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's a good point.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If everyone's wishes were already made[n]into reality, there wouldn't be any[n]requests on the Phan-Site.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Exactly.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Therefore, Maruki is likely choosing[n]certain targets with this system, then[n]affecting each one individually.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Probably using the same method[n]as when he made Violet's Persona[n]go berserk that one time.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Wha... Me!?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: From what I remember, Dr. Maruki[n]summoned these things that look like[n]tendrils, and they grabbed me...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Wait, don't tell me, are these...?
They're the same thing.
They "look like tendrils" to me.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You mean to say, these cables all across[n]Maruki's Palace and Mementos, they're[n]part of his... methods?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed. These are the "something"[n]Dr. Maruki is using to affect the[n]minds of others...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Such as Violet, for example.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Yes, that hypothesis explains much of[n]what we've seen if it were found to be[n]true.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Maruki is extending these cables[n]from his own Palace, tunneling into[n]the depths of Mementos...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And spreading his influence from[n]the same place the Holy Grail once[n]occupied.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That allows him to grant the "wishes"[n]of any people he may discover once[n]they've fallen under his influence.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Psh, screw that.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mmhm! This won't last much longer[n]now that we're here!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: 'Kay, but I'm the one who has to do the[n]actual hacking, though.

entries.speaker: Mechanical Voice
entries.en: ...ACCESS BY CONSULTATION SUBJECT CONFIRMED.

entries.speaker: Mechanical Voice
entries.en: TEMPORARILY SUSPEND RESEARCH[n]DATA STREAM?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, the displays are showing parts[n]of Mementos, right? I guess we can[n]suspend something here?
Gotta try to find out.
Let's see what it does.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You got it—I like the way you think!

entries.speaker: Mechanical Voice
entries.en: RESEARCH DATA STREAM SUSPENDED.[n]RETRACTING PIPELINES...

entries.speaker: Mechanical Voice
entries.en: TO RESUME DATA STREAMING—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, go ahead and shut up now.[n]We ain't resumin' shit.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Does this bring us any closer to[n]stopping Maruki?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: All we did was suspend the data sharing.[n]Stopping Maruki's a whole other story.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I don't think this'll interfere with[n]his effect on Mementos.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What? Then what good does suspending[n]the data stream do us?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: According to this console's output, all[n]the cable-tendrils are retracted now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Possibly including someplace in the[n]Palace that was blocked before?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We won't know unless we check it out[n]for ourselves.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What say we head to the Palace next?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, we've done what we can here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Next on our agenda: a return to[n]Maruki's Palace!
